title: Slim Atlas ResourceSpace Portal Cleanup
description: Build a clean slim Atlas portal branch from origin/main. Atlas should match the prior prototype visual direction while acting only as a simpler UI layer on top of ResourceSpace. ResourceSpace remains the DAM/search/review/write truth. Google Shared Drive remains master-original custody.
referenceArtifacts: Supplied Atlas DAM prototype image set from June 21-22, 2026
productThesis: Atlas is a thin ResourceSpace companion portal. It improves church-user interactions but does not become a second DAM.

visualTarget.name: Prior Atlas DAM prototype
mustKeep: dense asset grid and table browsing
review queue and review detail screen
mustChange: replace generic stock/product labels with TJC/ResourceSpace-safe domain language
keep ResourceSpace as source of truth

resourceSpacePolicy.boundary: Atlas wraps ResourceSpace search, assets, collections, upload, review, and metadata fields with simpler church-user UI.
resourceSpacePolicy.writePolicy: ResourceSpace first, confirmed by post-write re-read.
resourceSpacePolicy.failurePolicy: Queue or fail closed. Never claim success when ResourceSpace did not confirm.
resourceSpacePolicy.localQueue: Allowed only as fallback or pending state. It is not source of truth.

noTouchRules: Do not delete, rename, move, or mutate source media.
Do not remove worktrees or folders before archive and explicit approval.
Do not force push, reset, deploy, publish, mutate hosted services, or change credentials without explicit approval.
Do not claim beta-ready or production-ready from local-only evidence.
Do not commit church media files, runtime data, secrets, private URLs, signed URLs, source paths, checksums, or original filenames.

userStories.title: Create approved PRD and slim cleanup JSON
userStories.description: As the orchestrator, I need durable PRD artifacts that encode the slim Atlas direction before any branch cleanup begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Human-readable PRD exists under docs/product.
Ralph-ready JSON exists under docs/product.
Artifacts state Atlas is a thin ResourceSpace UI layer, not a second DAM.
START_HERE, command matrix, and live surface docs name Slim Atlas ResourceSpace portal as current canon.
Artifacts reference the prior Atlas prototype and supplied image set.
Artifacts list approval gates for destructive cleanup, source media, deploys, resets, and force pushes.
Root prd.json is not overwritten while it contains unrelated dirty work unless user explicitly approves replacing it.

userStories.title: Archive dirty worktree state
userStories.description: As an operator, I need every active worktree and dirty branch captured before creating the clean slim branch.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive captures main worktree, local DAM worktree, prototype worktree, and detached temp worktree status.
Archive includes branch, HEAD, status, tracked diff stat, patch bundles, and untracked file list.
Archive does not include source media, secrets, runtime data, node_modules, build artifacts, or private originals.
No worktree or folder is removed in this issue.
Git hygiene guard passes after archive artifacts are staged or explicitly ignored.

userStories.title: Create clean slim branch from origin/main
userStories.description: As an implementer, I need a clean branch from origin/main so enterprise replacement work does not leak in by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Branch codex/atlas-thin-resourcespace-portal is created from origin/main.
No dirty files from codex/atlas-new are carried over automatically.
No source media, runtime data, or secrets are copied.
Branch starts with passing git diff --check.
Branch creation is recorded for handoff.

userStories.title: Reapply prototype-style Atlas shell and core ResourceSpace workflows
userStories.description: As a church media user, I need Atlas to feel like the prior prototype while reading and writing through ResourceSpace truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Library/search screen uses prototype-inspired shell, grid/table browsing, filters, and selected-asset inspector.
Asset detail answers can-use, why, scope, and next action in first viewport.
ResourceSpace collections/open albums are browsable without creating a separate package/distribution truth.
Request/review routes support permission requests and reviewer decisions with ResourceSpace confirmation semantics.
Upload/intake defaults submissions to Needs Review / Do Not Publish and routes large media safely.
Normal roles do not receive source paths, checksums, private URLs, signed URLs, or admin internals.

userStories.title: Remove or de-canonicalize enterprise replacement surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the app surface to match slim portal scope and stop presenting Atlas as an enterprise DAM replacement.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboards and command-center UI are removed from canonical navigation or archived as non-canonical reference.
Packages/distribution sets do not remain a separate source of truth.
Broad governance/admin command center surfaces are removed or reduced to minimal diagnostics.
Enterprise beta-ready and production-ready claims are removed from canonical app/docs unless separately proven.
Tests are updated so they enforce slim portal scope rather than old enterprise readiness scope.

userStories.title: Update docs, tests, and guards for thin portal
userStories.description: As a future agent, I need docs and validation to describe and protect the actual slim Atlas architecture.
acceptanceCriteria: README or START_HERE explains Atlas as a local thin ResourceSpace companion portal.
Docs state ResourceSpace remains DAM truth and Google Shared Drive remains master-original custody.
Docs avoid beta/production overclaims from local-only proof.
Validation gates include typecheck, tests, build, git hygiene, and focused core portal smoke.
Obsolete enterprise readiness guard expectations are removed or scoped to non-canonical archive docs.
Enterprise DAM, package/distribution, dashboard, command-center, beta-readiness, and production-readiness artifacts are reference evidence only unless later re-canonicalized.

userStories.title: Run validation and request cleanup approval
userStories.description: As the operator, I need proof that the slim branch is safe before any stale worktree or folder removal is requested.
acceptanceCriteria: git diff --check passes.
npm --prefix frontend run typecheck passes.
npm --prefix frontend run test passes or failures are documented as blockers.
npm --prefix frontend run build passes.
node scripts/git-hygiene-guard.mjs passes.
Focused smoke covers /library, /assets/[id], collections/open album route, /requests or /review, and /upload.
Final report asks explicit approval before deleting old worktrees, pruning folders, or removing stale branches.

separateApprovalRequired: delete, move, rename, or mutate source media
force push, reset, or destructive Git action
hosted mutation, production deploy, public publishing, credential change, or paid external usage
replace current root prd.json while it contains unrelated dirty work
